"# Make a simple mobile merge tower defense game: \"Carrot Planet Defense\"

## Concept
A tiny round planet with a big Carrot Field in the center. Cute rabbits guard it.
Hungry animals (mice, water deer, wild boars) come from ALL directions toward the center to eat the carrots.
The player buys rabbit defenders, MERGES two of the same level into a stronger one, and taps enemies to help.
Style: cute, bright, cartoon, 2D top-down view. Portrait mode for mobile.

## Screen Layout
- Center: Carrot Field with an HP bar (starts at 100 HP).
- Around the field: a ring of 12 defender slots (circle around the center).
- Below the planet: a \"Bench\" with 5 extra slots for storing rabbits.
- Top bar: Carrots (currency), Wave number, Carrot Field HP.
- Bottom: big \"Buy Rabbit\" button showing its price.

## Core Rules
1. Enemies spawn at the edge of the screen from random directions and walk straight to the center.
2. When an enemy reaches the Carrot Field, it eats: Field loses HP equal to the enemy's damage, and the enemy disappears.
3. Rabbits in the ring slots automatically attack the nearest enemy in range.
4. Rabbits on the Bench do NOT attack.
5. Killing enemies gives Carrots.
6. Field HP reaches 0 → Game Over screen showing the wave reached, with a \"Retry\" button.

## Buying @COMMENT_BODY@ Merging (the main fun)
- \"Buy Rabbit\" gives a Level 1 rabbit of a random type, placed in the first empty slot.
- Price starts at 10 carrots and increases by 5 each purchase.
- Drag a rabbit onto another rabbit of the SAME type and SAME level → they merge into ONE rabbit of the next level (max Level 6).
- Each level: attack x2, slightly bigger, and a different hat or color so levels are easy to tell apart.
- Drag rabbits freely between ring slots and bench slots.
- Drag a rabbit to a trash icon to sell it for half its value.

## Rabbit Types (only 3)
| Type | Attack | Speed | Range | Special |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Carrot Thrower | 5 | 1 shot/sec | Medium | Basic single target |
| Bomb Bunny | 8 | 1 shot/2 sec | Short | Small explosion hits nearby enemies |
| Ice Bunny | 3 | 1 shot/sec | Medium | Slows enemy 40% for 2 sec |

## Enemies (only 3 + boss)
| Enemy | HP | Speed | Damage to Field | Reward |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mouse | 10 | Fast | 1 | 2 carrots |
| Water Deer | 30 | Medium | 3 | 5 carrots |
| Wild Boar | 80 | Slow | 8 | 12 carrots |
| Boss: Giant Boar (every 10th wave) | 500 | Slow | 30 | 100 carrots |
- Enemy HP increases by 10% each wave.

## Waves
- Wave 1–3: mice only. Wave 4+: mice + water deer. Wave 7+: add wild boars. Every 10th wave: boss.
- Each wave has (5 + wave number × 2) enemies.
- 5-second break between waves with a \"Next Wave\" countdown.
- The game continues endlessly; goal is to survive as long as possible.

## Tap Attack (clicker part)
- Tapping an enemy deals 2 damage (+1 every 5 waves) with a small carrot-splat effect.

## Idle Part (keep simple)
- The Carrot Field produces 1 carrot every 2 seconds automatically.
- Save the best wave record and current game with local storage.

## Feedback @COMMENT_BODY@ Juice
- Damage numbers pop up above enemies.
- Rabbits do a little hop when they attack.
- Merging shows a sparkle + \"Level Up!\" text.
- Carrot Field shakes and flashes red when eaten.
- Simple sounds: throw, explosion, merge chime, coin pop.

## Priority
Build in this order and make sure each works before adding the next:
1) Enemies walking to center + Field HP + Game Over
2) Buying rabbits and auto attack
3) Drag-and-drop merge
4) Waves and boss
5) Tap attack, idle income, effects, sound
"
